notes: Replication source is the final 2023 Collabra publication deposited in the assigned OSF project, with the matching title and study; author order and year differ from the supplied 2022 reference. Reported success records the authors’ overall study verdict, not an inferred verdict for this individual statistic. Original recruited sample (87 female and 81 male) is not substituted for analytic N: reported error df 154 leave test-specific inclusion unclear. The neutral description does not identify shame versus guilt or distinguish the public exposure × moral belief interaction from separate exposure effects under high and low moral beliefs. Multiple tests meet this wording on both cited pages; no unique test selected. Papers are available.
